title: It almost took Claude longer to create this gameplay trailer, than to make the underlying game.
author: CapitanUncino19
selftext:
You can try the game here: [https://capitanuncino.itch.io/handvoll](https://capitanuncino.itch.io/handvoll)

Would love some feedback about the gameplay mechanics and artstyle.  
  
I am thinking of turning this into a mobile game and releasing it on the play store. Is is worth the effort? What are your experiences?

Everything was made with Opus 5.5 in the Claude desktop app. Every shot is recorded from the real game, running in a browser that a script controls. The script sets up each scene (the camp, raiders, catapults and camera angle), then plays it like a player would, moving the hand with real mouse input to grab, throw and cast. The game advances one frame at a time, so every frame renders at full 1080p and the game’s own sound is recorded along with it. A second script cuts the takes on the beat at their key moments, generates a music score with accents on the hits, lowers the music under the game sound, and adds a small zoom on the bigger hits plus the end card.
